entities.name: Yzaak
entities.description: Izzet cyclops attendant to the guildmage Madarrak on Ravnica, killed by Abrupt Decay.

entities.name: Madarrak
entities.description: Izzet scientist and guildmage who followed a homing beacon into the Undercity.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Izzet guildmaster who bid Madarrak seek the beacon's maker.

entities.name: Erno Zslod
entities.description: Lost chemister who made the homing beacon and vanished over thirty years earlier.

entities.name: Golgari sentries
entities.description: Sentries following Madarrak's party in hiding.

entities.name: Undercity
entities.description: Ruins beneath Ravnica where the beacon led.

events.summary: Madarrak is bid by Niv-Mizzet to find the beacon's maker, Erno Zslod.
events.quote: Madarrak was bid by Niv-Mizzet to seek out the beacon's maker

events.summary: Madarrak, Castan and Yzaak follow the beacon into the Undercity; Madarrak has Yzaak stand guard.
events.quote: Madarrak bid the large and powerful Yzaak to stand guard through the way they had come

events.summary: Madarrak, chased by kraul, returns to find Yzaak killed by Abrupt Decay and teleports away, leaving the corpse.

relations.quote: attendant to the scientist and guildmage Madarrak
